get.description: Liveness only. It touches neither the database nor Kraken.

post.description: Trades a refresh token for a new pair. The token presented is used up.

Ends this sign-in: its refresh tokens are revoked and both cookies removed.

An access token already issued keeps working until it expires, at most
`JWT_TTL_MINUTES` later. That is the trade of every stateless access token (spec §15).

ApproveIn.title: ApproveIn
ApproveIn.description: The version read. An approval of any other is refused (spec §8).

CadenceMode.title: CadenceMode
CadenceMode.description: `MIN` is the system minimum cadence. `INTERVAL` uses the days, months and anchor.

ConfigPatch.title: ConfigPatch
ConfigPatch.description:
Every field optional. `next_invest_at` and `next_rebalance_at` are absent on purpose:
the scheduler owns them, and `extra="forbid"` turns an attempt into a 422.

HoldingOut.title: HoldingOut
HoldingOut.description: One asset of a snapshot. Every amount a decimal string, or null when it has none.

LegOut.title: LegOut
LegOut.description: One leg of an operation. Every amount is a plain decimal string.

ProposalLegOut.title: ProposalLegOut
ProposalLegOut.description: One leg as it was proposed, the skipped ones too, with why.

RefreshIn.title: RefreshIn
RefreshIn.description: The body of a refresh or a logout. A browser sends no body and relies on the cookie.
